claim_attributions.claim_text: Deterministic readiness: primed (score 77.0). The athlete is primed based on recent training load being compatible with current preparedness and no obvious fatigue stacking. The recent load supports continued aerobic development without significant strain, aligning with the beginner / low-volume athlete profile. Long-run durability and uphill economy are prioritized over sharpening, which is appropriate given the current phase context as a base development block.
Ensure adequate hydration and nutrition post-run.
Focus on recovery activities such as stretching, foam rolling, and light massage.
Consider incorporating some form of active recovery, like a short walk or easy bike ride, to further aid recovery.
Monitor heart rate variability (HRV) and resting heart rate (RHR) to ensure they are trending positively.
Continue to prioritize sleep quality and duration, aiming for 7-9 hours per night.
Maintain a balanced diet rich in carbohydrates, proteins, and healthy fats to support muscle repair and recovery.
Stay well-hydrated throughout the day, especially after runs.
Avoid alcohol and excessive caffeine, which can disrupt sleep and recovery.
Listen to your body and adjust intensity and volume as needed to avoid overtraining.
